newsitem.title: USA: Small plane crashes in Florida, killing three.
newsitem.headline: Small plane crashes in Florida, killing three.

text.p: A single-engine plane crashed and burned Monday at a small airfield near West Palm Beach, killing all three people on board, authorities said.

Witnesses said those aboard the 1960s-era aircraft were practicing touch-and-go landings when the plane went down in a grassy area at North County Airport in the northwest area of Palm Beach County, Sheriffs Office spokesman Paul Miller said.
"The witnesses heard a loud noise and the engine stalled," Miller said. "Suddenly the plane took a sharp turn to the left and nosedived into a grassy area and burst into flames."
The first police officers at the scene tried to put out the blaze with fire extinguishers to no avail, Miller said.
Three people on board were burned beyond recognition, he said.
Investigators from the Federal Aviation Administration and the National Transportation Safety Board were expected at the crash scene Tuesday.
